subject: Patriots Day Ceremonies
overview: Medford officials, veterans groups, and community members gathered for annual Patriots Day observances, including a POW MIA ceremony, a grave decoration service at Salem Street Burying Ground, and a re-enactment of Paul Revere's ride.

items.title: POW MIA Flag Raising Ceremony
items.summary: City officials and veterans gathered at City Hall for a POW MIA flag-raising ceremony featuring remarks on war prisoners and missing service members by City Councilor Alfred Pompeo.

items.title: Revolutionary War Memorial Service at Salem Street Burying Ground
items.summary: Participants assembled at Salem Street Burying Ground to hear Governor William Weld's Patriots Day proclamation, an address by Council President Robert Maiocco, and to decorate the graves of Revolutionary War soldiers.

items.title: Community Remarks
items.summary: Local veterans, school officials, and American Legion Auxiliary leaders offered public comments during the ceremonies.

items.title: Re-enactment of Paul Revere's Ride
items.summary: Spectators gathered to hear a recitation of Longfellow's poem and greet a re-enactor portraying Paul Revere during his ride toward Lexington.
